data.title: CSX and Wounded Warrior Project host robotics, drone training for 21 veterans
data.description: Twenty-one military veterans gathered at the CSX Moncrief Yard on Tuesday for a hands-on training session in robotics and drone flight.
data.keywords: Wounded Warrior Project, military veterans, David Schneider, Sean Gallup, CSX Moncrief Yard, career training, Getty Images, drone pilot, Kevin Rasch, Brian Morgan, surveillance drone
